**Time.** 120 minutes total, including your video, timer starts on open.

### The situation

You carry three fictional composite accounts this week.

**Bellhaven Retail Group.** A mid-market retailer, live since March on an AI-driven inventory forecasting engine. Status is reported green. Phase 2, adding a markdown-timing recommendation layer, kicks off in two weeks.

**Kestrel Health Partners.** A regional healthcare claims processor. Ajaia is building a claims audit export tool for their compliance team. A deliverable is due to the client tomorrow morning, and their external auditors arrive Thursday.

**Vantage Freight Systems.** A trucking dispatch company. Ajaia's dispatch copilot has been live for six weeks. Adoption is stuck at 30% of eligible dispatchers using it weekly.

You have five pieces of material below.

**Material 2. Draft deliverable, Kestrel Health Partners, Claims Audit Export Tool, Field Mapping Spec v0.9, due tomorrow 9am**

A few terms in the spec, in case they are new to you: a provider NPI is a clinician's national identification number, a CPT code identifies the procedure performed, and an ICD-10 code identifies the diagnosis. You do not need healthcare experience to complete this task.

> Export target: external auditor review portal, read-only, outside Kestrel's internal systems.
>
> Fields included in export:

- Claim ID
- Date of service
- Provider NPI
- CPT procedure code
- Billed amount
- Patient full name
- Patient date of birth
- Patient Social Security Number
- Primary diagnosis code (ICD-10)
- Patient home address

### Tasks

**Task 1. The portfolio call** (suggested 20 minutes). What you do about each of the three accounts this week. Name the one account you lose sleep over, and state the tradeoff you are making by prioritizing it the way you do.

**Task 2. The quality decision** (suggested 25 minutes). Ship, fix, or delay the Kestrel deliverable. Then write, in full, the client message that goes with your choice. This is not a summary of what you would say. Write the message.

**Task 3. The adoption play** (suggested 20 minutes). A two-week plan to move Vantage's adoption number, naming who does what.

**Task 4. AI Workflow Note** (suggested 10 minutes). Which tools you used for which parts of this assignment, what you kept human and why, and one thing you checked or rejected that a tool gave you.

### Your video, recorded inside the timer

One video, 5 to 10 minutes, suggested 15 minutes to record. Walk us through your portfolio call, your quality decision, and your adoption play as if you were briefing your own manager on a Friday afternoon, in your own words, not a script read of what you wrote. Close the same recording with who you are, why this role, why Ajaia, and your salary expectations for this role. Do not tell us your current compensation. We do not ask for it anywhere in this process.
